messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync - Cloud marketplace + HW partner + SI integration for Summit launch. Need licensing signoff and a joint announcement timeline.
Liam Chen: I'm on it. Can you drop the proposed redistribution clause so legal can review? shortest possible pls.
Maya Patel: Sure — core ask: we need non-exclusive redistribution rights for our marketplace bundle, attribution to provider, and the ability to ship quantized variants. No transfer of IP.
Rohan Gupta: Also flag: for Dedicated/Private customers we should allow model pinning to provider version. Does that affect license?
Liam Chen: Pinning is fine as long as we clarify derivative works and hosting scopes. I'll draft a short addendum.
Sofia Alvarez: From infra side, hardware partner wants a SKU that includes optimized kernels + a validated quantization profile. We should list which binary blobs they supply vs what we provide.
Maya Patel: Good call. We should have 3 delivery artifacts: (1) model weights (open license), (2) vendor optimization pack (proprietary), (3) packaging manifest + inference test vectors.
Tess Morgan: Marketing note — we need embargo dates and logo usage terms from partner for the joint announcement. Also a 48hr technical preview window for press.
Maya Patel: Propose timeline: Legal signoff by Tue, engineering verification Wed-Thu, partner review Fri, announce next Wed. Thoughts?
Liam Chen: Tue signoff tight but doable if partner returns edits today. I'll ping them.
Rohan Gupta: Engineering needs an explicit test plan. Sofia can you paste a minimal checklist?
Sofia Alvarez: Minimal checklist:
```
- run inference with sample prompts (latency/throughput)
- verify KV cache persistence across requests
- validate quantized outputs within quality delta (>=98% similarity)
- run export compliance scan on training data provenance
```
Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll attach that to partner ask.
Tess Morgan: For the joint blog + tweet, ask partner for a short quote + logo svg by Monday EOD. If delayed we publish with a neutral statement.
Liam Chen: Draft license snippet for review (very short):
```
Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide right to distribute and host the model weights via Redwood Marketplace and Dedicated/Private offerings. Provider retains ownership of model weights and may require attribution. Redistribution does not transfer IP.
```
Maya Patel: Thanks — can you add a line about quantized variants being permitted for performance?
Liam Chen: Added.
announce-bot: Reminder: partner_nda_signed = true (automated).
Rohan Gupta: One more integration ask — SI needs a tech integration doc (API hooks, sample deployment yaml, test vector bucket). Maya can we own that?
Maya Patel: Yes, I'll coordinate docs with SI and engineering.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll start the deployment yaml stub and share in this thread when ready.
Tess Morgan: Who's owning the embargo control? We should centralize with comms to avoid leaks.
Maya Patel: Comms team (Tess) owns embargo control. I'll circulate the embargo window after partner confirms.
Liam Chen: Okay legal will circulate the addendum in-line as comments in the doc. Please review as soon as I push.
Maya Patel: Great sync. Action items: Liam — addendum draft; Sofia — test checklist + yaml; Tess — embargo coord + logo request; Rohan — SI doc list; Maya — consolidate and send to partner.
Rohan Gupta: +1. Thanks team.
Tess Morgan: :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: I'll ping partner now and post updates here.
